Application Data.NAME: Smith Engineering Solutions, LLC
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Smith Engineering Solutions, LLC provides comprehensive engineering and surveying services, specializing in civil engineering, site development, and structural design. Our operations include assessing site conditions, conducting surveys, and providing design solutions for residential, commercial, and infrastructure projects. We emphasize meticulous planning, adherence to safety standards, and quality assurance to mitigate risks associated with design errors and site surveys. Our team employs advanced technology and software to accurately collect and analyze data, ensuring project integrity and compliance with regulatory requirements. We are committed to maintaining professional liability insurance and implementing risk management strategies to protect our clients and stakeholders.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 12, 2022, a minor loss occurred due to a surveying equipment malfunction, resulting in a $2,500 repair cost. The incident was reported to the insurance company, and the claim was closed on April 20, 2022, with payment processed. On October 5, 2022, an additional claim was filed for a design error in a civil engineering project, leading to a $12,500 cost for redesign and rework. The claim is currently open, with an expected resolution by December 2023. Total losses amount to $15,000.
Application Data.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B, Grade 1 Safe with UL certification, capable of holding $250,000 in cash and valuables.
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Security fencing installed around the perimeter of the office facility, monitored by a security service during non-business hours, and a surveillance camera system for added safety.
